tests.name: unflatten_long_key_array_tokens
tests.intent: Probes unflatten behavior on a deeply nested key consisting of thousands of /0 tokens to verify linearity.

tests.name: ordered_json_overlapping_keys_prefix
tests.intent: Probes ordered_json unflatten error handling when a shorter key is processed after its extension, triggering a type_error.

tests.name: ordered_json_overlapping_keys_null_override
tests.intent: Probes ordered_json unflatten allowing a null value to override an existing container branch gracefully.

tests.name: unflatten_short_limit_boundary
tests.intent: Probes unflatten around the 64-byte boundary for token prefix hashing versus tree storage.

tests.name: unflatten_shuffled_keys_ordered_json
tests.intent: Probes ordered_json unflatten with mixed array and object tokens in shuffled order.

tests.name: unflatten_empty_key_conflict
tests.intent: Probes unflatten error behavior when an empty key conflicts with a non-null root path.

tests.name: standard_json_overlapping_keys
tests.intent: Probes standard nlohmann::json behavior on overlapping keys which naturally sorts shorter keys first.

tests.name: unflatten_array_index_prefix_conflict
tests.intent: Probes unflatten throwing type_error when an array index prefix overlaps with a primitive value assignment.

tests.name: unflatten_escaped_tokens
tests.intent: Probes prefix tree and hash set handling of escaped characters in json pointer tokens during unflatten.

tests.name: unflatten_deep_mixed_structure
tests.intent: Probes unflatten correctness on a deeply interleaved array and object path structure.

tests.name: unflatten_multiple_same_hash_short_keys
tests.intent: Probes hash collisions in short prefix map by injecting multiple short keys.

tests.name: unflatten_empty_object
tests.intent: Probes unflatten on an empty json object input.

tests.name: unflatten_non_object_input
tests.intent: Probes unflatten behavior when called on a non-object json value such as an array or primitive.

tests.name: unflatten_numeric_string_tokens
tests.intent: Probes unflatten distinction between array index '0' and numeric-looking object keys like '00' or '1'.

tests.name: unflatten_large_number_of_unique_long_keys
tests.intent: Probes prefix tree memory and performance scaling with thousands of unique long keys.

tests.name: unflatten_consecutive_identical_prefixes
tests.intent: Probes optimization paths where consecutive keys share identical prefix spans.

tests.name: unflatten_array_prefix_without_zero
tests.intent: Probes unflatten behavior when a key has multiple tokens but no '0' token, ensuring it builds an object.

tests.name: unflatten_invalid_pointer_syntax
tests.intent: Probes unflatten behavior when keys do not start with a slash separator.

tests.name: unflatten_multiple_null_overrides_ordered
tests.intent: Probes ordered_json unflatten with multiple null overrides in conflicting positions.

tests.name: unflatten_roundtrip_flatten
tests.intent: Probes roundtrip consistency of flatten and unflatten on a complex nested structure.

tests.name: test_prefix_tree_walk_chain_shrink
tests.intent: Exercises prefix_tree chain shrinking when a subsequent key shares a shorter common prefix than the previous key's walk chain.

tests.name: test_prefix_tree_lower_bound_walk
tests.intent: Exercises prefix_tree walk lower_bound logic where an earlier lookup walked further and requires retrieving an intermediate step from the chain via lower_bound.

tests.name: test_prefix_tree_hash_collision_chain
tests.intent: Exercises prefix_tree child lookup hash collision resolution loop when multiple distinct long tokens map to the same hash bucket slot.

tests.name: test_array_prefix_set_empty_and_short_limit
tests.intent: Exercises array_prefix_set empty() checking both hash table and prefix_tree, along with short_limit boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_prefix_tree_deep_nested_structure
tests.intent: Exercises deep prefix tree construction, vector allocations, node re-hashing and table growth during unflatten with extensive long reference tokens.
